# CONTAINS on a text array is exact and case-sensitive
tags CONTAINS 'go'

# ... so 'Go' matches only Bob
tags CONTAINS 'Go'

# On an array, a quoted string is a list of required elements
tags CONTAINS 'go, sql'

# The list form requires every item too
tags CONTAINS ('go', 'sql')

# List items are never split, so this needs an element "go,sql"
tags CONTAINS ('go,sql')

# EXCLUDES matches empty and NULL arrays
tags EXCLUDES 'go'

# EXCLUDES with a list leaves out rows holding any item
tags EXCLUDES ('go', 'python')

# = NULL tests the array itself; an empty array is not NULL
tags = NULL

# != NULL keeps empty arrays
lucky_numbers != NULL

# An integer array with a single number
lucky_numbers CONTAINS 7

# An integer array with a quoted list
lucky_numbers CONTAINS '1, 3'

# A float array
ratings CONTAINS 4.5

# A numeric array compares numerically: 5 matches 5.00
prices CONTAINS 5

# A numeric array with a quoted value
prices CONTAINS '19.9'

# A boolean array
answers CONTAINS FALSE

# A boolean array with EXCLUDES
answers EXCLUDES FALSE

# A date array
holidays CONTAINS '2026-12-24'

# A timestamp array compares instants across offsets
logins CONTAINS '2026-10-27T12:00:00+02:00'

# A uuid array
friend_ids CONTAINS '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'

# An enum array
roles CONTAINS 'admin'

# An enum array with EXCLUDES and a list
roles EXCLUDES ('admin', 'editor')

# A non-nullable array is never NULL
roles = NULL
